mainEntity.name: Why does most of my early payment go to interest?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interest is calculated on the remaining loan balance, which is largest at the start of the loan — as the balance shrinks with each payment, less interest accrues and more of the payment goes toward principal.

mainEntity.name: Does paying extra toward principal reduce total interest?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, significantly — reducing the balance early means less interest accrues on it for the rest of the loan. Enter an extra monthly payment above to see the interest and time saved. Check that your lender applies extra payments to principal and doesn't charge a prepayment penalty.

mainEntity.name: Is this a full amortization schedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Switch the schedule between annual totals and every monthly payment, each showing principal, interest and the remaining balance, and use Print to save it.
